law_name: Copyright Act 1913 (Wet Auteursrecht 1913, Auteurswet) as amended up to S.B. 2015 No. 83
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (from 1 January of the year after death; anonymous/posthumous works 50 years from publication; per Commons summary)
orphan_works: Art. 39: where the author is not named or identity is not beyond doubt, copyright lasts 50 years from 1 January after first publication
fair_use_exceptions: Narrow exceptions: short quotations with source from newspapers (Art. 15bis); quotations in reviews and teaching anthologies (Art. 16); news reportage (Art. 16bis); few copies for own study (Art. 17)
enforcement_body: Courts: rightholders sue for damages and seizure (Arts. 27-28); criminal fines imposed by criminal courts (Arts. 31-32, 37)
notes: 2015 amendment challenged by collecting society SASUR before Constitutional Court (Feb 2024); WCT/WPPT not confirmed
